chunks: Al-Nawfaly, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said regarding the foetus of the animal: when it is struck and it aborts it, (the compensation is) one-tenth of its price.
ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for an aborted foetus in Islamic jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'arsh' (compensation for non-fatal injury) for an animal's foetus, ruling that striking a pregnant beast and causing abortion incurs a liability of one-tenth of the animal's value. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it distinguishes foetal compensation from full blood money (diyah), reflecting the early juristic consensus on the partial value of the unborn offspring in commercial and legal contexts.

en.hubeali:
Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said regarding a foetus of the animal when it is truck, so it aborts it, (the compensation is) being one-tenth of its price’.
